name: cometchat-skills
description: AI-native skill suite for integrating CometChat React UI Kit v6 into any React project. Skills teach Claude integration patterns, component APIs, and production hardening instead of relying on templates.

skills.name: cometchat
skills.description: Entry-point dispatcher. Detects framework, understands the project, recommends integration shape, and routes to the right skills.

skills.name: cometchat-core
skills.description: Foundational rules — initialization, login, CSS, env vars, SSR safety, provider pattern, and anti-patterns.

skills.name: cometchat-components
skills.description: Complete catalog of CometChat React UI Kit v6 components — names, props, and composition patterns.

skills.name: cometchat-placement
skills.description: Where to put chat — route, modal, drawer, embedded panel, or floating widget patterns.

skills.name: cometchat-react-patterns
skills.description: Integration patterns for React projects (Vite or CRA) — provider setup, routing, env vars.

skills.name: cometchat-nextjs-patterns
skills.description: Integration patterns for Next.js (App Router + Pages Router) — SSR prevention, dynamic imports, API routes.

skills.name: cometchat-react-router-patterns
skills.description: Integration patterns for React Router (v6 library + v7 framework mode) — outlet nesting, SSR guards.

skills.name: cometchat-astro-patterns
skills.description: Integration patterns for Astro — React islands, client:only rendering, island communication.

skills.name: cometchat-theming
skills.description: Theme customization — CSS variable overrides, preset themes, dark mode, brand color mapping.

skills.name: cometchat-features
skills.description: Feature catalog — calls, reactions, polls, AI features, and how to enable each one.

skills.name: cometchat-production
skills.description: Production readiness — server-side token auth, user management CRUD, environment hardening, security checklist.

skills.name: cometchat-customization
skills.description: Component customization — four-tier discovery, custom view slots, request builders, event subscriptions, and CSS overrides.

skills.name: cometchat-troubleshooting
skills.description: Diagnostics — verify checks, drift detection, error decoding, and targeted fixes.
